tracker.company: Maine Department of Administrative & Financial Services (OIT)
tracker.role_families: QA/test engineering; quality assurance leadership; IT systems and release testing
tracker.research_notes: Verified: DAFS/OIT publishes telework security guidance (state laptop, home Wi-Fi, state IT rules) but does not state Maine-residency eligibility. FY2026 biennial budget funds the agency, a strong stability signal. No QA openings or named QA leaders were found, so openings must be checked directly. Sources: https://www.maine.gov/dafs/careers https://maineit-docs.maine.gov/docs/other-security-considerations https://www.ncsl.org/fiscal/fy-2026-state-budget-status
tracker.maine_remote: unknown: The department publishes teleworking/remote access security guidance: use a state-provided computer, connect it to home Wi-Fi, and follow state I.T. rules wherever you work.
tracker.ai_summary: Maine's central IT agency runs and tests statewide systems (health, benefits, tax), so senior QA roles are plausible but rare and mostly in Augusta, ~1.5 hours from Bangor. Public-sector durability is excellent; the candidate's Maine residency and regulated V&V background
tracker.ai_red_flags: No QA openings listed; state hiring is slow and openings skew toward Augusta, not Downeast Maine.
tracker.approach_role: State CIO / Director, Office of Information Technology
tracker.outreach_notes: Your FDA-regulated V&V and design-controls experience maps directly to testing Maine's health, benefits and eligibility systems, and you live in-state, so hybrid or telework arrangements are workable.
